description:
A deeply customizable, offline home screen with gestures, folders and a feed.

Supernova is a home screen you can shape to fit the way you use your phone. It works fully offline: no account, no tracking, no ads and no internet permission.

Home screen and dock

  • Adjustable grid, icon size, labels and margins, and a dock with multiple pages
  • Widgets with resizing, padding and overlap (bring to front or send to back)
  • Multiple pages with scroll effects and a page indicator
  • Folders with custom previews, backgrounds and swipe-to-open

App drawer

  • Vertical grid, list or horizontal pages, with a fast scroller
  • Tabs and folders to group apps, a separate Work tab and hidden apps
  • Recently opened apps row and instant search for apps, contacts and calculations

Look and feel

  • Icon packs, custom icons and icon shapes, including themed icons
  • Notification badges in several styles (needs notification access)
  • Light, dark and automatic night mode
  • Launch, drawer and page transition animations

Gestures

Swipe, double tap, pinch and two-finger gestures can open apps, shortcuts, the drawer, notifications, search or lock the screen.

Feed and cards

An optional page beside the home screen with your calendar, media controls, starred contacts and your own cards. Cards hold apps and shortcuts or a widget, and you can pin, reorder and recolour them.

Backup

Export and restore your whole setup, including layout and settings, to a file, or bring your home screen over from another launcher's backup.

Permissions

Every permission is optional and only used for the feature that asks for it: contacts for search and the feed, calendar for the calendar card, phone for direct dial shortcuts, notification access for badges and the media card, and the accessibility service or device admin for gestures that lock the screen or open recents and quick settings.
